title: Vendor Catalog Corpus Index (VENDOR-NETWORK-MS0 / U-VDN-CATALOG-PULL)
description: Canonical index of the vendor/manufacturer cutting-tool catalog corpus expanded by charlie's VENDOR-NETWORK-MS0 catalog-pull campaign. The 6 named galaxies are wired to the relevant subset via a MARKED section in each PATHS.md (see scripts/wire-vendor-corpus-to-galaxies.mjs). This file is the single source of truth; the per-galaxy PATHS.md blocks are GENERATED from it. The pathway is the artifact path + its own index/manifest — never copy per-PDF rows into galaxy files. charlie owns acquisition + triage; oscar (speed-feed) owns the .ts S/F extraction.

speed-feed.label: oscar — Speed & Feed Calculator (PRIMARY consumer)
speed-feed.why: Extract S/F tables from the 44 HIGH/not-ingested catalogs into per-vendor mcp-server/src/data/<vendor>-speed-feed-data.ts. The SFC extraction manifest is the worklist; the pulled-PDFs dir is the source. Cite source page; never inline physics constants.
